title: Ruleset: story_lock
description: rules/<id>/story_lock.yaml: which maps, exits and cell sections each stage of the story opens (apps/session: StoryLockRules, docs/modulos/apps/session.md). Stage N opens the maps of stages 1 to N; only the active stage's exits and sections narrow them. The --story-stage launch option overrides active_stage, and 'all' opens everything.

mapPattern.description: A map id, or a prefix ending in '*'; '*' alone is every map.

active_stage.description: The stage played: the latest one delivered. One of the stages' ids.

closed_message.description: The text key of the message a closed exit shows.

id.description: The stage's id; 'all' is reserved for the launch option (the session refuses it).

maps.description: The maps this stage opens, added to those of the stages before it.

exits.description: While this stage is active: maps whose exits lead only to these open maps.

sections.description: While this stage is active: maps whose cells run only these sections of the map's script.
